The host's journey then takes him to Lleida, the produce heartland of Catalonia, for what could be the first day of the donut peach season

programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and the team set to work transforming a deserving young family's inaccessible and uninspiring garden in Dudley in the West Midlands. programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: Derby County v Leicester City (Kick-off 12.30pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents all the action from the Championship match at Pride Park. This is the first meeting between the sides since the 2016/17 season, when the teams drew 2-2 here in an FA Cup fourth-round tie, before Leicester won the replay 3-1 at King Power Stadium, and there was little between these clubs in the early stages of the current campaign. With analysis from Chris Martin and Marc Albrighton, reports from Aaron Paul, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward
